## Painting checklist

### General
- [ ] Obtain full sheet index and confirm SE3 is not the only issued package
- [ ] Request architectural plans (floor plans), RCPs, interior elevations, exterior elevations
- [ ] Request finish schedule / room finish matrix and paint legend (PT-1, PT-2, etc.)
- [ ] Request door & frame schedule + hardware set notes affecting finish
- [ ] Request Division 09 specifications (paint systems, prep, VOC, warranty)
- [ ] Confirm project phase boundaries for Phase #3 (what is new vs existing vs NIC)
- [ ] Confirm bid inclusions/exclusions (owner equipment, FF&E, graphics, signage)
- [ ] Confirm prevailing wage / union / insurance / tax status if applicable
- [ ] Clarify substrate assumptions (GWB, CMU, metal, wood, concrete, GFRC)
- [ ] Confirm primer requirements by substrate and condition (new vs existing)
- [ ] Confirm touch-up vs full repaint of adjacent existing work
- [ ] Document access, phasing, occupied-building constraints, and work hours
- [ ] Confirm mock-up / sample approval requirements
- [ ] Confirm protection, masking, and final clean responsibilities

### Interior
- [ ] Walls ΓÇö all rooms in Phase #3 (map PT systems; currently PT-1 = 0 LF)
- [ ] Ceilings ΓÇö painted GWB / exposed structure / soffits / bulkheads (currently 0 SF)
- [ ] Accent walls / brand colors / feature walls
- [ ] Columns, pilasters, and freestanding partitions
- [ ] Interior exposed steel / misc. metals (if paint, not galvanized leave-as-is)
- [ ] Stairs, stringers, risers, handrail/guard (paint vs factory finish)
- [ ] Toilet rooms / wet areas ΓÇö enamel / moisture-resistant systems
- [ ] Storage, MEP rooms, corridors, lobbies ΓÇö system per schedule
- [ ] Back-of-house vs public finish grade
- [ ] Above-ceiling / non-visible surfaces (only if specified)
- [ ] Paint grade vs wallcovering zones (no double-count)
- [ ] Patch & prime existing openings / demo scars if remodel interface

**Gym / fitness typical miss-items (carry until occupancy confirmed or N/A):**
- [ ] Cardio / free-weight / functional training zones ΓÇö wall SF and height to structure
- [ ] Mirror walls ΓÇö paint stops / returns / frames / edges (who paints?)
- [ ] Rubber floor / sports floor interface ΓÇö base type and paint hold-back
- [ ] Locker rooms / wet locker / showers ΓÇö epoxy or high-performance wall/ceiling systems
- [ ] Sauna / steam / spa rooms ΓÇö specialty high-heat/humidity systems or NIC
- [ ] Group fitness / cycle studio ΓÇö acoustic panels vs paint; ceiling color
- [ ] Juice bar / retail / reception ΓÇö accent paint and millwork field finish
- [ ] Kids club / offices / training rooms
- [ ] Ceiling fans / exposed duct / structure paint (if open ceiling)
- [ ] Equipment shadows / wall protection height ΓÇö paint full height vs wainscot
- [ ] Brand stripe / logo wall paint (vs vinyl graphics by others)
- [ ] TV / tablet mounts ΓÇö cutouts, boxes, and touch-up responsibility

### Exterior
- [ ] Exterior wall field paint / stain / elastomeric (if any in Phase #3)
- [ ] Soffits, fascia, eaves, canopies
- [ ] Exterior doors, frames, hollow metal
- [ ] Railings, bollards, site metal (paint vs galvanized)
- [ ] Parking structure / ramp walls if in phase
- [ ] Existing exterior touch-up at phase tie-ins
- [ ] Confirm climate / exposure system (alkyd vs acrylic vs high-build)

### Doors & frames
- [ ] Hollow metal frames ΓÇö prime + finish coats (count openings; currently 0 EA)
- [ ] Hollow metal doors ΓÇö faces and edges
- [ ] Wood doors ΓÇö field finish vs factory prefinish (NIC if prefinished)
- [ ] Door frames at new vs existing walls
- [ ] Borrowed lites / sidelites / transoms ΓÇö frames only vs glazing stops
- [ ] Access panels, fire extinguisher cabinets ΓÇö paint to match walls if specified
- [ ] Overhead / coiling doors ΓÇö field paint if required
- [ ] Confirm factory-primed vs raw steel; include primer where missing

### Specialty
- [ ] Epoxy / resinous wall systems (locker, kitchen, mop, trash)
- [ ] Intumescent / fireproofing topcoat (if structural steel in SE package)
- [ ] Anti-graffiti / high-traffic corridor coatings
- [ ] Dry-erase / magnetic paint zones
- [ ] Floor coatings (only if in painting scope ΓÇö often separate trade)
- [ ] Mechanical equipment / rooftop units (often by others)
- [ ] Conduit, piping, hangers ΓÇö paint if exposed and specified
- [ ] Exterior/interior signage backing panels
- [ ] Caulk & sealant for paint-grade joints (who owns?)

### Wallcovering
- [ ] Confirm any WC / vinyl / fabric zones on finish schedule (none listed)
- [ ] Wallcovering prep (skim, primer/sealer) in painting vs WC trade
- [ ] Border / accent strips
- [ ] Removal of existing wallcovering if remodel
- [ ] Exclude WC supply/install unless explicitly in painting scope

### Site
- [ ] Site bollards, gates, fences (paint)
- [ ] Dumpster enclosures / screen walls
- [ ] Light pole bases / utility screens if painted
- [ ] Striping / pavement markings (usually separate ΓÇö confirm)
- [ ] Landscape walls / CMU site walls
- [ ] Phase #3 site limits vs future phases

## Likely finish systems

*Systems are provisional until finish schedule / specs arrive. Use as bid-structure placeholders only.*

| Code (placeholder) | Typical use | Assumed system (verify) |
|--------------------|-------------|-------------------------|
| **PT-1** | General interior walls | Latex primer + 2 coats eggshell/satin acrylic (or per spec) |
| **PT-2** | Ceilings / soffits | Flat latex, 2 coats over primer as required |
| **PT-3** | Wet / toilet / locker | Semi-gloss acrylic or epoxy-modified system |
| **PT-4** | Doors & HM frames | DTM / alkyd or waterborne enamel, 2 finish coats over primer |
| **PT-5** | Accent / brand walls | Same as PT-1, color change; may need deep-base coats |
| **PT-E** | Exterior (if any) | Exterior acrylic or elastomeric per elevation notes |
| **EP-1** | Specialty wet walls | Epoxy wall system (locker/shower) ΓÇö confirm trade |
| **ST-1** | Exposed structure / steel | Shop prime + field finish or intumescent + topcoat |

**Substrate notes to lock later:** GWB Level 4/5; CMU fill + block filler; ferrous metal primer; galvanized prep; concrete densifier vs paint.

## Missing sheets / RFI questions

### Missing sheets (request immediately)
1. Full drawing index / sheet list for Phase #3  
2. Architectural floor plans (all levels in phase)  
3. Reflected ceiling plans  
4. Interior elevations and enlarged restroom/locker plans  
5. Exterior elevations (if exterior paint in phase)  
6. Door schedule, frame types, and door elevations  
7. Room finish schedule / finish legend / paint schedule  
8. Wall types / partition types (height, substrate)  
9. Specifications Division 09 91 00 (or project paint section)  
10. Any addenda, sketch revisions, or finish alternates  

### RFI questions
1. What is the occupancy/program for SUNRISE PHASE #3 (office, multifamily, retail, gym/fitness, other)?  
2. Do sheets `SE3 ΓÇö Mt` through `SE3 ┬╖ p5` constitute the complete bid set, or is an architectural package forthcoming?  
3. What are the Phase #3 physical limits (rooms, floors, exterior elevations) vs previous phases?  
4. Is there a paint legend defining PT-1 and related systems? Current takeoff shows PT-1 walls at 0 LF ΓÇö please issue quantities basis or allow plan takeoff from full set.  
5. Are hollow metal doors/frames field-painted or factory finished?  
6. Are wood doors prefinished (exclude) or field stained/painted?  
7. Any epoxy, intumescent, or specialty coatings in painting scope?  
8. Open ceilings: paint structure, deck, duct, and conduit ΓÇö yes/no?  
9. Existing surfaces: full repaint, blend, or new work only?  
10. Who owns wallcovering, graphics, mirrors, and rubber base interfaces?  
11. Confirm exterior painting in Phase #3 ΓÇö in or out.  
12. Phasing / occupied site / after-hours work requirements?

## Suggested takeoff conditions

Use these as **proposal / takeoff assumptions** until RFIs close:

1. **Basis of bid:** Takeoff deferred pending full architectural and finish documents; current zeros are placeholders, not final scope.  
2. **Phase limit:** Paint new construction and altered surfaces within Phase #3 limits only; existing adjacent spaces NIC unless noted for blend.  
3. **Interior walls:** Measure paint-grade wall area or LF ├ù height from plans; exclude WC zones, tile full-height, and FRP unless paint specified.  
4. **Ceilings:** Paint GWB ceilings and painted soffits only; ACT grid/tile NIC; exposed structure only if scheduled.  
5. **Doors & frames:** Count HM frames and doors as EA openings; wood prefinished NIC; glass NIC.  
6. **Base / trim:** Paint wood base/trim only if scheduled; rubber/vinyl base by others.  
7. **Height:** Standard to underside of ceiling or noted wall height; atrium/high walls separate line.  
8. **Colors:** Up to X standard colors (define with GC); deep/accent colors and brand colors as allowance or unit prices.  
9. **Prep:** Level 4 GWB assumed; Level 5 only if specified; CMU block fill where CMU is painted.  
10. **Exclusions (typical):** Wallcovering install, floor coatings unless noted, parking striping, equipment, FF&E, signage/vinyl graphics, caulking of expansion joints by others, patch beyond normal paint prep.  
11. **Unit prices recommended:** Accent wall SF; HM door/frame EA; high-reach >10'ΓÇô12'; epoxy wall SF; after-hours premium.  
12. **Gym/fitness hold:** Until program confirmed, keep separate allowance lines for locker epoxy, open-structure paint, and brand accent walls.

---

## Handoff notes for proposal writer

- **Do not present firm SF/LF/EA** from this sweep alone ΓÇö drawing set is incomplete and all current quantities are zero.  
- Lead with **qualifications**: scope based on partial SE3 package; final numbers after full A-set + finish schedule.  
- Structure WL Painting scope outline as: *General conditions ΓåÆ Interior field ΓåÆ Ceilings ΓåÆ Doors/frames ΓåÆ Specialty ΓåÆ Exterior (if any) ΓåÆ Exclusions ΓåÆ Unit prices ΓåÆ Allowances*.  
- Call out **Phase #3 boundary** and **existing-to-new blend** as commercial risk items.  
- Keep **gym/fitness miss-items** as open checklist until client confirms occupancy; if not a fitness build, mark N/A in Step 2.  
- SE3 sheets may contain structural steel ΓÇö if so, clarify **field paint vs fireproofing topcoat** ownership with GC.  
- Step 2 (formal WL Painting scope): after missing sheets/RFI answers, convert checked items into include/exclude language and takeoff quantities.
